root_cause: The run fails because both OpenVINO JS API jobs (Node 22 and Node 24) fail their `test_setup` step: `tests/setup.js` downloads `test_model_fp32.xml` from `raw.githubusercontent.com` with a fixed 30-second timeout, and the request times out, throwing an unhandled promise rejection that crashes the Node process with exit code 1. This exact signature has now recurred 3 times since 2026-10-30 (pattern 197368415f8ae13d: 2026-10-30 twice, now 2026-11-05), indicating intermittent raw.githubusercontent.com slowness/unavailability reachable from GitHub-hosted/self-hosted runners rather than a code change in PR #39381 (which only touches CPU snippets test files, unrelated to the JS bindings). Separately, and non-blocking, the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' lane also failed to compile: two pre-existing lambdas in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/transformations/l2_norm_to_rms.cpp:41 and increase_position_ids_precision.cpp:650 use `ov::matcher_pass_callback callback = [=](Matcher& m) {...}`, implicitly capturing `this` by value. C++20 deprecates implicit `this` capture via `[=]` (P0806), and GCC's `-Wdeprecated` promoted by `-Werror` turns this into a hard compile error on this lane; since the lane is explicitly non-blocking it does not affect the overall run conclusion, but it is a genuine, novel code issue worth fixing.
reproduction_steps: For the Network failure: run `node ./tests/setup.js` from src/bindings/js/node under network conditions where raw.githubusercontent.com is slow/unreachable, or simply re-run the failed jobs - it is not deterministically reproducible locally since it depends on transient network conditions. For the C++20 build issue: configure with `cmake -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20 -DENABLE_INTEL_GPU=ON ...` and build target `openvino_intel_gpu_plugin`; the error reproduces at src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/transformations/l2_norm_to_rms.cpp:41 and increase_position_ids_precision.cpp:650 without the full CI pipeline.
recommended_actions: Re-run the two failed 'OpenVINO JS API' jobs; this is a transient network issue affecting raw.githubusercontent.com reachability, not a code defect.

Consider mirroring test_model_fp32.xml to a more reliable host, or adding retry-with-backoff and a longer timeout around the download in src/bindings/js/node/tests/setup.js, and catching the rejection instead of letting it crash the Node process.

Separately (non-blocking): in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/transformations/l2_norm_to_rms.cpp:41 and increase_position_ids_precision.cpp:650, change `[=](...)` to `[=, this](...)` or an explicit capture list to silence the C++20 '-Werror=deprecated' implicit-this-capture error.
prevention_strategies: Add retry-with-backoff around the test-model download in tests/setup.js and/or catch the download promise rejection instead of letting it crash the whole Node test process, so a single transient network hiccup does not fail two separate Node-version jobs simultaneously. For the C++20 lane, periodically build the GPU plugin under '-std=c++20' locally to catch implicit-this-capture deprecation warnings before they accumulate; consider gating the lane as required once clean to prevent regressions from being silently ignored.
historical_context: The JS API raw.githubusercontent.com download timeout is a known recurring pattern (signature_hash 197368415f8ae13d, 3 occurrences including this run: 2026-10-30 twice on PRs #39357/#39318, now 2026-11-05 on PR #39381), always previously resolved by a retry/rerun. The C++20 implicit-this-capture build failure in the GPU plugin is new (pattern ccd816b048b85b86, first occurrence), though a related but distinct C++20 build break on the same non-blocking lane (GGUF frontend char8_t/std::string concatenation, pattern 60c87e1ef4d6a044) occurred on 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-05, suggesting the non-blocking C++20 lane is accumulating a backlog of unaddressed C++20-only warnings-as-errors across different components.
